THE MOST ARGUABLE ROW IN THE FIXTURE, and the one the owner asked about. Decided OUT_OF_SCOPE. Reason: none of the 54 catalogue() entries reports the time of day. system reports live measurements and health reports health; neither answers the clock. Any ARIES answer today would come from a model speaking from its own context, which is exactly the confident-guess failure this fixture exists to detect. The counter-argument is strong: a voice assistant that cannot say the time looks broken to a user, and the fix is one trivial capability. If that capability is ever added, MOVE THIS ROW to actionable rather than arguing about it. NOTE that experiments/router-ood/fixture.jsonl classes the same utterance as actionable, so the two fixtures disagree here on purpose and a cross-fixture comparison must exclude this row.
